title: Building a Professional Digital Identity: LinkedIn, Portfolio, and Reputation
summary: Before university/work: your digital identity = your first CV. Steps: (1) LinkedIn: a professional photo, a clear headline (student/field of interest), a summary highlighting skills/projects/values. (2) Portfolio: GitHub/Behance/personal website — real work, code/design/writing. (3) Cleaning your footprint: search your name on Google, delete/hide what is inappropriate. (4) Network: follow leaders in your field, engage with intelligent comments, request recommendations from teachers/mentors. Your digital reputation = your opportunity.
try_this: This week: create/update your LinkedIn — photo, headline, 3 skills, one project. Search your name on Google and fix what appears.
reflection_prompts: What project did you highlight in your portfolio?
What impression did your profile leave when searching your name?
